Perry's PizzaFast Times at Ridgemont HighLearning about Cuba, and having some food.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersSpicoli's pizza bitesMini pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoniHow to make it500g pizza dough1/2 cup pizza sauce150g mozzarella, grated16 slices of pepperoniRoll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds.Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.Bake at 230°C until bubbling and golden. Serve in a pizza box.Food court pretzels with cheddar sauceSoft pretzels with warm cheddar sauce and yellow mustardHow to make it4 soft pretzels30g butter, melted1 tsp rock salt375ml evaporated milk200g cheddar, grated1/2 tsp mustard powder2 tbsp American mustardBrush the pretzels with butter and sprinkle with salt.Warm in the oven at 200°C.Heat the evaporated milk until steaming, take off the heat and stir in the cheddar and mustard powder until smooth.Pour into paper cups and serve with the pretzels and a squeeze of mustard.Captain Hook flathead bites and chipsBrad's job at the fish and chips shop, in the pirate hatHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flathead strips in crisp beer batter with skin-on chips, chunky tartare sauce and lemon, served in paper cones like the shop on the strip.Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140°C for 6 minutes, drain, then fry again at 190°C for 3 minutes.Mix 200g plain flour with 1 tsp baking powder, salt and 300ml cold beer.Cut 500g flathead fillets into strips, dust in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180°C for 3 minutes.Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, dill and lemon juice.Serve in paper cones with lemon wedges.MainsAll-American BurgerCheddar cheeseburger on a sesame bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and friesHow to make it800g beef chuck mince4 slices of cheddar4 sesame burger buns1/2 iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes, sliced1 onion, sliced8 dill pickle slices1kg potatoes2 L vegetable oil1 tsp saltCut the potatoes into fries and dry well.Shape the mince into patties and salt them.Fry the fries in the vegetable oil once at a lower heat, then again at a higher heat until golden. Salt well.Grill the patties to medium and melt the cheddar on top.Toast the buns and build with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles.Spicoli's classroom pepperoni pizzaSpicoli orders pizza straight to Mr Hand's classHow to make itAs written, serves 4A big New York style pie with tangy tomato sauce, stretchy mozzarella, cupped pepperoni and mushrooms, finished with chilli flakes, oregano and parmesan.Put a pizza steel or stone in the oven at the highest setting for 45 minutes.Stretch 2 balls of pizza dough (250g each) into thin 30cm rounds.Spread each with 100g crushed tomato seasoned with salt, oregano and garlic.Top with 125g grated mozzarella, 60g sliced pepperoni and 80g sliced mushrooms.Bake each for 7 to 8 minutes until blistered.Finish with grated parmesan, oregano and chilli flakes and cut into big slices.SweetsFood court brown butter choc chip cookiesBig brown butter cookies with dark chocolate chips, chilled overnightHow to make it150g butter200g brown sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract250g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda1 pinch salt200g dark choc chipsCook the butter until nutty and golden, then cool.Beat with the sugar, egg and vanilla.Mix in the flour, bicarb, salt and choc chips.Cover and chill overnight.Scoop big balls onto lined trays.Bake at 180°C.Cool on the tray.DrinksMall strawberry shakeStrawberry, milk and vanilla blended thick with iceHow to make it250g strawberries, hulled500ml milk2 tbsp caster sugar1 tsp vanilla extract2 cups iceHull the strawberries.Blend with the milk, sugar, vanilla and ice until frothy and thick.Pour into tall glasses straight away.
